description: Import key material (or a key reference resolved to octets) into the process keystore and return a CryptoKey handle. Algorithm is a string registry name or object with name (and optional length for AES-GCM). Default extractable is false. Requires execute access.

parameters.description: Raw binary key, or reference object { from: environment|file|material, ... }.
parameters.name: keySource

parameters.description: Algorithm string or object { name, length? }.
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.description: Optional usages; defaults depend on algorithm family.
parameters.name: usages

parameters.description: If true, crypto_export_key may export raw key. Default false.
parameters.name: extractable
